caseName: National Labor Relations Board v. Clark's Gamble Corp.
caseNameFull: National Labor Relations Board v. Clark's Gamble Corp., dba Clark's Discount Department Store

opinions.text:
C. A. 6th Cir. Motion to use record in No. 439, October Term, 1969, granted. Certiorari denied.

Mr. Justice Black, Mr. Justice White, and Mr. Justice Blackmun are of the opinion that certiorari should be granted.
